Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn't. The [On Deletion] effect activates after the card moves to your trash, therefore the Digimon where this card is a digivolution card won't be in the battle area and can't meet the condition.
Card Q&A.q: If this card is a digivolution card, does the Digimon above it meet the condition of this card's [On Deletion] effect?

Inherited Effect: [On Deletion] If you have a Digimon in play, ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
